The contest-wide figures are the contests' totals and the county parts their county rows, so the check that the parts add up to the totals compares two reports of the same system in one file, not independent documents (the federal contests are also compared with the Clerk of the House's statistics).

the archive's number of seats for these races is the size of the whole body or more, not what the race elects, and no other official count is at hand, so no seat count or winner is stored: Yorktown School Board

neither the archive's titles for these races nor its own districts for them name a place that can be read (for example 'Metropolitan School Board, South'), so they are stored under their county with no place id: Wabash: Metropolitan School Board, Northeast; Wabash: Metropolitan School Board, Northwest; Wabash: Metropolitan School Board, South; Ohio: School Board Member
The Election Division's archive reports every contest by county only. Precinct figures are each county election board's own (92 offices, each in its own format); they are not read here.
